title: Client products file (Finspot OMS, Investor Products Enabled)
purpose: The products a client login may use, across its enabled segments: I (MIS, intraday) when any segment is open, M (NRML, carry forward) when a derivatives segment (equity F&O, currency, commodity) is open, C (CNC, delivery) when equity cash is open; in Finspot's order I,M,C. Codes as the Margin Basket sheet gives them (I = MIS, C = CNC, M = NRML). Written for the same clients as the Investor Client file.
source: Finspot File_Formats.xlsx, sheet Investor  Products Enabled (2 columns; the client sample's title line is 'Client Products Enabled')
